name: Vampire Survivors
coreLoopDuration: 30 seconds - kill enemies → collect gems → level up → choose upgrade
sessionLoopDuration: 15-30 minutes - survive waves → unlock new character/weapon → retry
metaLoopDescription: Unlock progression - each run unlocks new content for future runs
successFactors: Removed all friction - no aiming, no complex controls
Streamable - viewers can follow along easily
innovationPoints: Inverted bullet-hell - player IS the bullet hell
Build synergies emerge from simple choices
designLessons: Constant small rewards > rare big rewards
Content unlocks create "one more run" loop
avoidMistakes: Dont add complexity to chase hardcore players
Avoid long runs that prevent quick sessions

name: Hades
coreLoopDuration: 2-3 minutes - clear room → choose boon → manage resources
sessionLoopDuration: 20-45 minutes - full run attempt → story progression → unlock permanent upgrades
metaLoopDescription: Story unfolds through death - each death advances relationships and narrative
successFactors: Death IS the story mechanic - failure feels purposeful
Every NPC remembers your actions between runs
Voice acting for everything creates immersion
innovationPoints: Roguelike that makes death feel good narratively
Early Access built community before launch
designLessons: Polish > content volume for premium pricing
Every system should reinforce the core fantasy
avoidMistakes: Dont launch without narrative justification for loops
Voice acting is expensive - budget carefully

name: Slay the Spire
coreLoopDuration: 1-2 minutes - draw cards → play cards → resolve combat → choose reward
sessionLoopDuration: 45-90 minutes - climb spire → adapt deck to encounters → boss fights
metaLoopDescription: Ascension climbing - beat game to unlock harder modifiers, master each character
successFactors: Perfect information - no hidden RNG in combat
Every card choice matters to final build
communitySize: Huge modding community, active speedrun scene
designLessons: Genre fusion can create new categories
Let players see all information to feel smart
avoidMistakes: Dont hide information players need to make decisions
Avoid power creep in card additions

name: Balatro
coreLoopDuration: 30 seconds - play poker hand → apply joker modifiers → score points → buy upgrades
sessionLoopDuration: 30-60 minutes - beat blinds → acquire jokers → scale into absurd numbers
metaLoopDescription: Unlock new jokers, decks, and modifiers by completing challenges
successFactors: Leveraged universal poker knowledge - zero tutorial needed
Perfect for content creators - dramatic big hands
innovationPoints: Familiar game with completely new depth
designLessons: Use familiar systems (poker) to reduce onboarding
Let players feel clever by finding combos
avoidMistakes: Dont balance away the fun - broken combos are the point
